working_definition: Cells of the adult heart (posterior pulsatile region of the dorsal vessel); in FCA these are cardial cells (wall cells of the heart tube).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Cell that forms the wall of the adult dorsal vessel. There are 84 of these cells per dorsal vessel (Lehmacher et al., 2012).

justification: Authors' term FBbt:00003154 (adult heart) is an organ region; FBbt has no 'cell of adult heart' term. Adult cardial cell is the most specific cell term that is a parent of the wall cells of the heart.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: The caudal, pulsatile region of the adult dorsal vessel.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Authors' organ term; not a cell term.

recommendation: Use adult cardial cell (FBbt:00058240) as a broad match.
